title: Advisor: a fourth verifier, for judgement that needs no fact only the owner has
item: Add a read-only advisor agent on Fable at high effort. It verifies the pass lines assigned to it, is consulted before a park, checks a builder's decision that changes what a pass line proves, and drafts the next task of a chain as Proposed
motivation: Of the three times task 49 needed the owner on 2026-11-17, one was judgement with no owner-only fact in it: label 27 transcripts blind, say how strong the result is, write the next tasks. The owner carried the transcripts to Claude in chat, the same model the advisor would be. An advisor inside the manager removes that trip. The owner's review should hold only what truly needs him: money and accounts, facts about his product, taste the first time a format appears, his own fields, DECISIONS.md, anything that cannot be undone.
notes: Jobs. (a) Verify a pass line assigned to it, such as blind labelling: it gets a fresh context, read-only tools, and only the paths the line names (for labelling: the transcripts, never the verdicts). (b) Before any park: say whether the task can go on without the owner, and how. (c) When a builder logs a decision under decided_for_you that changes what a done_means line proves, say whether the line still proves what it was written to prove; if not, the task goes back to the builder once with that reply. (d) After a task merges: for a Proposed task that hard-depends on it and has an empty done_means, draft its fields from the results; it stays Proposed. Assigning lines. 'advisor' becomes a valid value of verified_by. A new optional field, verifier_of_line, maps the number of a done_means line, written '(n)' in the text, to one verifier; a line not in the map is verified by every verifier in verified_by, as today. What the advisor never does, decided by a script and not by the advisor: rule on a line whose verifier is you; unpark a task whose runs_as is you; override a failed protected-path check or a failed outside-need check (task 57); spend money or touch accounts; change an owner's field; set Ready; anything on the never list. A task with one line for the owner still parks for that line, after the advisor's lines are done, and its question names only the owner's lines. Record. Every advisor reply is saved verbatim in tasks/advice/<id>-<n>.md and its ruling is logged under decided_for_you with what would change it. Its agent definition sets model and effort explicitly, like every agent in this repo. First real use: task 56, line 3. Claude in chat labels the same transcripts separately, to compare.
done_means: (1) An agent manager-advisor exists with model Fable, effort high and read-only tools, linked in .claude/agents/ like the other two. (2) tasks.py lint accepts 'advisor' in verified_by and the optional field verifier_of_line, and rejects a key that is not a line number written in done_means or a value that is not a verifier; references/task-fields.md documents both. (3) For a line whose verifier is advisor, commands/manage.md dispatches the advisor with only the paths the line names, saves the reply in tasks/advice/<id>-<n>.md and logs the ruling under decided_for_you; a checks.py command refuses a merge while an advisor line has no saved reply whose first line is 'RULING: HOLDS'. (4) commands/manage.md consults the advisor before every park except the always-park cases in the notes, and a checks.py command decides those cases; tests show each of them always parks. (5) commands/manage.md has jobs (c) and (d) as steps. (6) The manager tests pass, all of them.
draft_note: First drafted by Claude on 2026-11-15; rewritten by Claude in chat on 2026-11-17 on the owner's go, after task 49. Changed from the first draft: the advisor has four jobs, not one; 'verified by you' blocks it per pass line, not per task; the always-park cases are decided by a script. It widens what merges without the owner; he approves that by setting it to Ready. If it parks twice, stop and go on with the BDD path, with Claude in chat as labeller. The owner asked on 2026-11-17 to read the changed manager rules before this task merges ("read 37"), so verified_by includes you. Set to Ready the same day on his instruction.
for_retry: Review 037-1, minor: `advisor.md` line 20. The blindness of job (a) rests only on the brief; the Read tool can open the verdicts. This is inherent to the tools, but worth knowing.

needs_you.question: task 37 waits for the owner's check: verified_by includes you and owner_verified is empty. You asked to read the changed manager rules before this merges. The build is on branch task/037 (commit 6603a3b); the review passed (tasks/reviews/037-1.md) and every command it named exits 0, 119 tests pass. Read `git diff re-create-from-scratch...task/037`, mainly SKILL.md rule 7, commands/manage.md and agents/advisor.md.
needs_you.recommendation: Before setting owner_verified, decide on review minor 1: if verified_by has both advisor and you, an unmapped done_means line belongs to both, check_advice demands a HOLDS reply the manager is told never to request, and the task can never merge. No task has that today. I recommend merging as is and fixing it in Proposed task 60, with lint rejecting advisor and you together on an unmapped line. If you agree, set owner_verified to the date and Ready again; the next run merges task/037 with no further park.
needs_you.if_vetoed: If you want minor 1 fixed first, add it to for_retry (or the notes) and set Ready; the next run sends a builder to fix it on the task's branch, reviews again, and still needs your owner_verified. If you reject the design, set the task to Backlog or Dropped; task/037 stays unmerged and task 56's line 3 keeps going to you.

decided_for_you.chosen: advisor reply files numbered like tasks/reviews/, with a `JOB: a (<n>)` second line tying a reply to its line
decided_for_you.rejected: n as the line number, which would overwrite earlier rulings
decided_for_you.would_change: if you read <id>-<n> as line n

decided_for_you.chosen: the latest advisor reply on a line counts at merge
tasks/advice/ is a named protected path, so a task branch cannot plant a HOLDS ruling
decided_for_you.would_change: if a task ever needs to write advice on its branch

decided_for_you.chosen: verifier_of_line accepts any verifier, not only those in verified_by
decided_for_you.rejected: requiring the two fields to agree, which would make an advisor-only line pull the advisor onto every unmapped line
decided_for_you.would_change: if you want the two fields to agree

decided_for_you.chosen: owner lines worked out per line: verified_by with you but every line mapped elsewhere has no owner line
decided_for_you.rejected: parking whenever you is in verified_by
decided_for_you.would_change: if you want the stricter reading

decided_for_you.chosen: verifier_of_line is an owner field, locked once Ready
decided_for_you.rejected: a manager field, which would let the manager move a you line to the advisor
decided_for_you.would_change: if you want the manager to map lines

decided_for_you.chosen: park reasons are a fixed word list in checks.py consult; always-park is exactly the eight cases in the notes; merge-limit, review and advice refusals consult the advisor
decided_for_you.would_change: if you add them to always-park (review minor 3 argues for it)

decided_for_you.chosen: at most one advisor GO ON is followed per task run; a later park parks with the advisor's reply in the recommendation
decided_for_you.would_change: if you want more retries per run

decided_for_you.chosen: the manager judges which builder decisions change what a line proves (job c)
decided_for_you.rejected: asking the advisor about every decision, or having the builder tag them
decided_for_you.would_change: if job c misses a decision that mattered

decided_for_you.chosen: job (d) picks the tasks to draft with checks.py drafts and commits the draft as `task <Y>: drafted from task <X>` after the merge
decided_for_you.rejected: the manager picking them by reading
decided_for_you.would_change: if drafting manager-made findings tasks (like 59) is unwanted

decided_for_you.chosen: review findings sorted by checks.py unmerged: only the advisor.md one went to for_retry; the rest name files that also exist on the working branch, so they went to Proposed task 60 even though the code they fault is new on task/037
decided_for_you.would_change: if checks.py unmerged is changed to look at changed lines, not whole files
